description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Robinhood is hiring a backend Software Engineer for its Core Financial Products Engineering team. The role designs, builds, tests, and maintains reliable, scalable backend infrastructure and services that power financial products, collaborating with cross-functional teams and external financial institutions.
Backend engineer building reliable financial services and integrating external financial institutions

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, test, and release backend systems with high correctness, reliability, and scalability requirements
• Own and maintain key services that power our financial product ecosystem
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex engineering and business challenges
• Interface with external financial institutions to integrate services and expand capabilities
• Contribute to shaping engineering best practices and improving developer workflows

Requirements:
• 6 Months - 2 Years of Hands-on software engineering experience through previous roles
• Proficiency with Python/Django or Go (or similar backend technologies)
• Solid understanding of relational databases and transaction-safe design
• Curiosity and interest in financial systems or a strong desire to learn
• Strong computer science fundamentals and a problem-solving mindset
